question: Which major obstacle continues to hinder India’s digital progress?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Digital gap & privacy issues***

 
 
• The passage notes that a persistent digital divide exists, especially between urban and rural areas. It also highlights concerns around data privacy, cybersecurity, and misinformation as pressing issues in India’s digital journey.
 
 
 
• ***Other Options***
 
 
• ISP monopolies, low phone manufacturing, and excess foreign capital are not mentioned as major obstacles in the passage.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3: Digital gap & privacy issues**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: ISP monopolies** – Not discussed in the passage.
 
• **Option 2: Low phone manufacturing** – Not highlighted as an obstacle in the passage.
 
• **Option 4: Excess foreign capital** – Not mentioned at all.
 
• **Option 3: Digital gap & privacy issues** – Specifically identified as ongoing challenges in the passage.
